title: Two-card gluing at a unique-copy pair with factorizing automorphism group (t4 section 6, anchor A1)
statement_en: Every graph G on at least 3 vertices with a pair u != v such that the two-deleted subgraph F = G - {u, v} occurs as an induced subgraph of G only on its own vertex set, and every automorphism g of F factors as g = k h^{-1} with h fixing N(v) on F setwise and k fixing N(u) on F setwise (Aut(F) = Stab(N(u)) Stab(N(v))), is reconstructible. (Sketch t4 section 6, extending t2 lemma C; no source found, attribution UNVERIFIED.)
statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => (∃ u v : Fin n, u ≠ v ∧ (∀ T : Finset (Fin n), Nonempty (G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce (T : Set (Fin n))) → (T : Set (Fin n)) = {u, v}ᶜ) ∧ ∀ g : G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∃ h : G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), (∀ x : ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), G.Adj v (h x).1 ↔ G.Adj v x.1) ∧ (∀ x : ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), G.Adj u (g (h x)).1 ↔ G.Adj u x.1)))
